places.name: Alcazaba of Málaga
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved Moorish fortress offering panoramic views of the city and a glimpse into Málaga's rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during public holidays.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for climbing.

places.name: Castillo de Gibralfaro
places.ai_summary: A historic castle perched on a hill, offering stunning views of Málaga and the Mediterranean Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for the views.

places.name: Málaga Cathedral
places.ai_summary: An iconic symbol of the city, this Renaissance cathedral is known for its impressive architecture and beautiful interior.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the cathedral's museum.
